To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the number of tourists and their activities were significantly correlated to the number of confirmed COVID-19 cases in Thailand.
the COVID 19 spreading was significantly correlated with the number of tourist in Thailand.

the number of infected cases were significantly associated with the economic factor, namely, number of tourist, and the influencing factor of slow increased rate of infected was the enforcement and implementation regulation, the strength the health care system, culture and social relation and the partnership among various government and private sectors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a case study of COVID 19 in Thailand and the factors that influence the spread of COVID 19.
the factors that affect the spread of Covid-19 in Thailand and its control.
the situation of COVID 19 and its influencing factors of spreading, and control.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the government should take care of the people’s health and safety, the government should be able to control the movement of people, the government should have the ability to control the economy and the government should have a good relationship with the public and other stakeholders.
the COVID 19 situation was under control and the number of new cases was not increased significantly.
the COVID 19 spreading in Thailand could be controlled by the strength of the health care system, public awareness and social supporting, and enforcement and implementation of government regulation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the government should be more strict on the enforcement of the regulation.
the government should consider and prepare for future outbreak by improving health care system and public awareness.
the number of infected, and confirmed COVID 19 was significantly correlated with the number of tourist.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the number of visitors, especially the international visitors, might be one of the influencing factors for COVID 19 spreading in Thailand.
the number of tourists was significantly associated with the number of infected cases.
the government should be more aware and careful about the number of tourists and their activities.
